label: Perfect local detection of assertion errors
definition: PerfectLocalDetection C F means F = Cᶜ: a local check flags exactly the local errors, with no misses and no false alarms. It remains blind to failure of the shared condition.
note: Idealized limit case for #1584 test 3; the general cross-check formula covers imperfect checks. No actual check is claimed to be perfect. See docs/notes/preface-connectivity-1584.md.
